name: Destiny Calls
summary: Syurna sends you to learn what Sethir the Ancient knows of Teldrassil's corruption. The satyr waits near the Oracle Glade, beyond the reach of those who tried force or diplomacy.

sections.title: A Silent Reconnaissance
sections.body: Teldrassil's growing sickness troubles the night elf leaders in Darnassus. Syurna, the rogue trainer, needs someone subtle; armed patrols have died trying to reach Sethir the Ancient. The satyr roosts on a remote bough near the Oracle Glade and has turned away force and diplomacy alike. To learn what he knows, you need to enter his lair and take his personal possessions.

sections.title: A Looming Shadow from Darkshore
sections.body: Sethir the Ancient's journal links Teldrassil's taint to the rot and corruption consuming Darkshore's forests and waterways across the misty sea. The sickness is not confined to the soil beneath the World Tree. Its reach points to a deliberate malice threatening the kaldorei heartland.

faq.answer: Sethir the Ancient is a satyr hiding on a bough near the northern edge of Teldrassil's Oracle Glade. He has defeated armed attackers and turned away peaceful inquiries from those seeking what he knows about the island's corruption.

faq.q: Why does Syurna want Sethir's journal?
faq.answer: Syurna believes Sethir's journal holds clues to the unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil. Its pages describe his activities and the dark taint.

faq.q: What does the journal reveal upon completion?
faq.answer: Sethir's journal links the sickness in Teldrassil's boughs to the demonic blight gripping Darkshore's ancient forests and coastlines across the channel.

aliases: where do i get destiny calls
faq.answer: Syurna, the rogue trainer in Darnassus, gives you this work after an initial assessment of your abilities.

faq.q: Where should adventurers go after completing this mission?
faq.answer: Syurna says nothing more can be done here about the matter. She rewards you with a blade for your service to Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is a rogue trainer handling forest corruption instead of druids?
faq.answer: Force and druidic diplomacy have both failed against Sethir, with deadly results. Syurna turns to stealth and infiltration after open efforts end in bloodshed.

angles.text: As a rogue, you test your skill at taking sensitive intelligence from under a dangerous satyr's nose, at the direction of Darnassus's stealth trainers.
As a kaldorei defender, you learn that Darkshore's ancient curse has crossed the sea into Teldrassil, threatening your sacred refuge.
As an Alliance defender, you learn that corruption in Teldrassil's woods reaches beyond the island, toward the northern lands of Kalimdor.
